name: launch-stackwright
description: Launch a new Stackwright project with the otter raft ready to build

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "const p=require('./package.json');const fields=[...Object.values(p.dependencies||{}),...Object.values(p.peerDependencies||{})];const bad=fields.filter(v=>String(v).includes('workspace:'));if(bad.length){console.error('ERR: workspace: specifiers found in publishable dep fields:',bad);process.exit(1)}"
